bar.raise_as_high: Raise {unit} as high as you can
bar.take_the_room: Take as much of the room as you can
battle.declined: You let that one go. The room cools.
battle.default_pattern: This opponent has no move pattern of their own yet, so they are using the shared default from rules.json and playing generically.
battle.no_stage: There is no stage to play here.
battle.one_at_a_time: {count} of them, one at a time. You are on {number}.
battle.passed: You said nothing. One less energy this turn.
battle.question_stakes: A strong answer pleases them. A weak one annoys them.
battle.shared_pool_rules: Winning over somebody undecided takes one point. Somebody already against you takes one, two or three — you find out which as you go, and points you cannot spend are lost.
battle.stance_line: Stance on {bill}: {lean}. With you: {with}. Against you: {against}.
brief.decay: their interest cools by {count}, whatever you say.
brief.energy.per_turn: {count} a turn, back in full when you end the turn.
brief.energy.pool: {count} for the whole thing. They do NOT come back at the start of a turn — spend them as a budget.{left}
brief.gaffes.multiplied: {count} ends the stage at once — and every slip here counts {multiplier} times.
brief.guard: it banks up to {count} and carries between turns. Only an attack takes it, and it is spent stopping one.
brief.hand.none: {count} cards, and you draw no more. Run out and there is nothing left to say.
brief.hand.refill: drawn back up to {count} at the end of every turn.
brief.heading: How this room works
brief.questions.decline: Leave one unanswered when the turn ends and you have declined it
brief.questions.ends_stage: , and here that ends the stage.
brief.questions.several: {per_turn} a turn, {total} in all. A further card still plays, but nobody is waiting for it.
brief.turns.limit: {count}. Running out of them is a loss.
brief.turns.none: no limit. It ends when the questions run out.
brief.winning.continuous: {count} {unit} finishes the one in front of you, not the stage. Your record, your hand and the clock carry across all of them.
brief.winning.hold: hold the room until the questions run out.
brief.winning.reset: {count} {unit} wins the argument in front of you. The next one starts again from nothing, gaffes included.
brief.winning.score: there is nothing to reach. However high the support gets by the end is the result, and later stages draw on it.
brief.winning.stream: {count} {unit} moves the queue along. The clock and your record carry; each new face is fresh energy.
brief.winning.survival_rising: Stay at {count} {unit} or above at the end of every turn. After each turn the threshold rises by {min} to {max}.
briefing.bill_line: This level is about {bill}, brought by {party}.
briefing.loss_continues: Losing this stage costs you, but the level carries on.
briefing.loss_ends_level: Losing this stage ends the level.
briefing.reporters_ask: The reporters ask the questions here.
caption.question: Question {number} of {total}
card.does_nothing: Nothing this card does counts in this room.
card.question_medium: This question doesn't care how you answer it.
card.question_strong: This question plays right into your hands.
card.question_weak: This question works against you here.
card.room_enhanced: This room favors this rhetorical style.
card.room_greatly_enhanced: This room greatly favors this rhetorical style.
card.room_greatly_suppressed: This room strongly resists this rhetorical style.
card.room_suppressed: This room resists this rhetorical style.
carried.nothing: Nothing carried over from the earlier stages.
draft.busy: Finish the level you are in first.
draft.cannot_start: The bill could not be drafted.
draft.conflict: Two of these parts work against each other.

draft.too_many: A bill carries three parts at most.
floor_vote.influence_not_ready: Your influence is not yet strong enough to sway other parties. Still needed: {needs}.

floor_vote.preview_heading: If the vote went each way:

floor_vote.title: The vote is in.
how_to_play.empty: The guide has not been written yet.

level_intro.party_neutral: Your party, {party}, has taken no position on it.
level_intro.stance_taken: Your stance: {lean}. With you: {with}. Against you: {against}.
narration.gain_none: {who} pressed the case and won nobody over.
narration.nothing_to_take: the attack found nothing to take
new_game.blurb: Who are you in Parliament? You play the whole run as the one you choose.
new_game.title: Choose your champion
office.backing_blurb: An organization backs you once your standing with it is high enough. Answering a reporter in the rhetorical style their question invites is what raises it.
office.backup_failed: The backup could not be written.
office.backup_label: {when} · Last level cleared: {level} · Inventory: {items} · XP: {xp} · Funds: {funds}
office.backup_none: No backup has been made yet.
office.backup_overwrite: Replace the backup ({backup}) with your current run?
office.backup_restore_warning: This replaces your current run with the backup made {when}. Anything done since is lost.
office.backup_undo_warning: This returns you to the run you had just before you loaded: {saved}.
office.cosmetics_blurb: Purely decorative — an outfit, an office look, and music, all yours to mix and match.
office.deck_tap: Tap a card to take it in or leave it out.
office.fire_staff_warning: Firing {name} costs {cost}円 in severance. They will never work for you again.
office.funds_buys: Earned by winning stages. Buys the organizations' backing and staff.
office.levels_blurb: Each level is a run of stages. Pick one and you will see what it holds before you commit.
office.new_game_started: A new run begins. Welcome to the Office, {name}.
office.new_game_warning: Starting a new game ends this run. Your standing, cards, staff and items all go back to the start.
office.not_active_yet: Not active yet — this effect is still to be built.
office.orgs_blurb: Answering a reporter in the rhetorical style their question invites pleases the organization behind it, and that standing is carried between levels.
office.record_bills_empty: None yet — a strong enough influence swing can flip a close vote.
office.record_law_failed: {name}: failed, {yes} Aye to {no} Nay with {abstain} abstaining. You voted {vote}.
office.record_law_passed: {name}: passed, {yes} Aye to {no} Nay with {abstain} abstaining. You voted {vote}.
office.record_statute_empty: No bill has come to a vote yet.
office.report.lost: Your performance is … stirring up rumors.
office.report.none: Chatter fills the National Assembly halls.
office.requests_hint: Organizations that think well of you are asking you to sponsor a bill.
office.resume_choice_body: Pick up where you left off, or set this level aside and start fresh from the Office.
office.special_forced_body: {level} cannot wait. It is the next thing on your desk.
office.staff_blurb: Each role can hold one hire at a time. Hiring, upgrading and firing are all paid from Funds — firing costs a severance, and someone you fire will never work for you again.
office.staff_fired: Fired — will not work for you again.
office.title: The Office
office.trigger.funding_freeze.entered: Party support hit zero. Funding is frozen until it recovers.
office.trigger.funding_freeze.left: Party support has recovered. Funding has resumed.
office.trigger.gaffe_penalty.entered: {count} gaffes this run — Constituency support took a {amount} hit.
office.trigger.steering_committee.entere: Party support fell to {count}. The Steering Committee has noticed.
office.trigger.town_hall.entered: Constituency support fell to {count}. Your district is growing restless.
office.xp_buys: Earned by winning stages. Buys new cards.

outcome.no_rewards: This stage has no rewards set yet.

outcome.sign_off_unwritten: That is the end of it.

party_opinion.allies_blurb: Friends of this party. The higher their standing with you, the better.
party_opinion.blurb: How each party sees you: its mood about your votes and rewards, blended with how its stakeholder organizations feel about you.
party_opinion.popup_blurb: Organizations this party counts as friends or opponents. An ally's standing with you counts for the party; a rival's standing counts against it.
party_opinion.rivals_blurb: Opponents of this party. The lower their standing with you, the better.

patron_visit.choice_b: Yes, with changes to protect others.

record.law_each: At the end of every later level:

request.amended: Amended: the rewards are {percent}% of the usual.

trade.asked_hint: They want the plan to {component} gone.
trade.caption: Round {number} of {total}
trade.cost_none: It costs you nothing this time.
trade.cost_seats: Their lobbying costs your side on the floor: -{count}.
trade.done_deal_body: You give up the plan to {component}. {name} agrees to: {gains}.
trade.gain_help: help with the vote (+{count} on the floor)
trade.keep_all: Keep the whole bill (end the meeting)
trade.offer_text: {name}, speaking for {org}, has come to bargain over your bill. Hear them out?
trade.package_text: Leverage {leverage}. Choose what you want in return; the cost so far is {cost}.

trade.react_medium_1: {name} considers it and gives nothing away.
trade.react_medium_2: {name} taps the table. Not bad, not enough.
trade.react_medium_3: {name} shrugs. They have heard it before.
trade.react_strong_1: {name} nods. That is a fair point.
trade.react_strong_3: {name} concedes the point with a thin smile.
trade.react_weak_2: {name} pushes the paper back across the table.

visit.brief_1: {staff} leans in. "{name} only really listens to {first}. Anything else, they tune out."
visit.brief_2: {staff} leans in. "{name} tends to respond to {first}, and will hear out {second}. Anything else, they tune out."
visit.brief_3: {staff} leans in. "{name} tends to respond to {first} and {second}. They will hear out {third}, and they are cold to the rest."
visit.caption: Question {number} of {total}
visit.done_body: Rapport with {name}: {rapport}. The fight begins with {bonus} support for you.
visit.offer_text: {name} of {party} has come to talk. Win them over, and they stand with you on this vote. Take the visit?
visit.react_medium_3: {name} makes a note and says nothing.
visit.react_strong_1: {name} nods slowly. That is the kind of answer they respect.
visit.react_weak_2: {name} folds their arms and looks away.
visit.react_weak_3: {name} sighs. You have lost some ground.
visit.style.divisive: a firm line against the other side
visit.style.emotional: a story that touches the heart
